title: Pip-Squeak the Mouse and the Giant Feather
description: A tiny mouse learns how to use a large fallen feather as a wonderful cozy blanket for his nest.
character_reference: a tiny brown field mouse with large round ears and a long twitching pink nose

scenes.narration: Pip-Squeak shivered in his hollow tree nest as a chilly evening breeze drifted through the bark. His old moss blanket was worn thin, and he needed something warmer.
scenes.visual: interior of a hollow tree cavity with textured wood grain and cool blue evening light

scenes.narration: He scampered out onto the woodland floor and discovered a magnificent snowy-white owl feather resting in the grass. To him, it looked as huge as a sailboat.
scenes.visual: close-up of a large soft white feather lying among green clover leaves and damp soil

scenes.narration: Using his paws, he tried to drag the giant treasure across the dirt, but it was far too heavy for one little mouse. He sat down and scratched his head in thought.
scenes.visual: small brown mouse with large ears standing beside a large white feather on the ground

scenes.narration: Instead of pulling it all at once, Pip-Squeak carefully climbed on top and tucked the silky down layers around his shoulders like a royal cape.
scenes.visual: small furry mouse sitting on a large white feather wrapped around his back like a blanket

scenes.narration: By folding the flexible quill, he managed to carry the fluffy prize all the way back up into his hollow tree home without any trouble at all.
scenes.visual: small mouse clutching a fluffy white quill while climbing up rough textured tree bark

scenes.narration: He spread the soft white plumes across his nest, creating the coziest, warmest bed in the entire forest. It felt like sleeping on a cloud.
scenes.visual: cozy tree hollow lined with soft white feathers and warm amber light

scenes.narration: Snuggling deep under his new feather blanket, Pip-Squeak closed his eyes with a happy squeak. Even the smallest creatures can find the biggest comforts.
scenes.visual: small mouse tucked comfortably under soft white feathers with eyes closed in peaceful sleep

scenes.narration: May your bed be warm and your dreams be gentle tonight. Follow along for more gentle bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: gentle moonlight filtering through forest leaves onto a peaceful, quiet woodland floor
